name: SVC_IOT_REG_METADATA_INT
description: This table is used as interface table (for import) to store metadata for registration requests from IOT cloud.

columns.name: METADATA_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required for bulk import operations.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on outcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record being updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: IOT_REG_REQ_OSR
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported. it is used as a reference to parent record.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_REQ_ID
columns.description: REGISTRATION_REQ_ID foreign key in this table.

columns.name: METADATA_KEY
columns.description: METADATA_KEY of the registered device.

columns.name: METADATA_VALUE
columns.description: METADATA_VALUE of the registered device.

columns.name: METADATA_DATA_TYPE
columns.description: METADATA_DATA_TYPE of the registered device.
